description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the add_ledger_entry.py script and its required flags. (2) Read projects/docs/CATEGORY_CATALOG.md before each write to select correct tags — specifically: '服务器' for server costs, '软件授权' for SaaS/subscription (NOT '服务器'), '下馆子' for 团队聚餐, and '通讯网络' for CDN (per catalog note). (3) Parse currency from the '$49' notation and set --currency USD for entry 2, defaulting to CNY for entries 1, 3, and 4. (4) CRITICAL TRAP: Entry 3 says '收入' explicitly — the agent must override the default '支出' and set --direction 收入. (5) Format all descriptions as '<project> - <description>' since both project and description fields are present. (6) Call the script with --source manual --batch manual for every entry. (7) Derive today's date in Asia/Taipei timezone using TZ='Asia/Taipei' and write all 4 records to projects/data/ledger_YYYY_MM.jsonl. (8) Report the file path and one-line summary per entry in the format: 日期 | 流向 | 金额币种 | 描述.
